text: The team outlined action items including defending the design in the final presentation (0) and specifying technical functions by the UI Designer (1) and generating user requirements by the Marketing Expert (2). The Industrial Designer will work on the conceptual design (3) and produce a working design (4). There are ongoing problems including unclear time to draw with risk of delay (5) and uncertainty about preparation level (6). Decisions indicate PM sets a prototype by end of day (7), pricing at 25 euros (8), production cost as half of the selling price (9), a question about whether phase one should cover the functional design (10), an assumption that the scope is TV/video (11), and a requirement for the least amount of functions (12).
